description.text: The major of international economy and trade trains senior applied talents who systematically master international economy and trade theory, have strong international economic and trade business operation ability, good business communication ability, good scientific research and innovation ability to think independently and solve problems, and engage in economic and trade business, international business and economic research

duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at Chang'an University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: On the application system of our university, applicants must fill in information in Chinese or English and submit application materials online.1. Valid Ordinary Passport.If the applicant is in China, a valid residence permit is also required.2. The highest degree certificate. Graduating students can provide a pre-graduation letter as a substitute, and have to bring the original certificate when they come to China.3. Transcripts.4. "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners"(Attachment 3).Applicants should strictly follow the items required in the "Physical Examination Records for Foreigners" and fill them out in Chinese or English. The “Physical Examination Record for Foreigners” missing pages or without a photo or a cross-page seal on it, or without a signature of physician or seal from hospital is invalid. Whereas the inspection results are valid in 6 months, applicants are requested to determine the time of their medical examination accordingly.5. Valid non-criminal record certificate within 6 months. If the applicant is already in China, she/he can only provide performance letter or Non-objection certificate from current university.6. Proof of Language Proficiency.7. Study Plan for Bachelor or Research Plan for Master and PhD.8. Two recommendation letters signed by (associate) professors (Undergraduate students are exempt).9. Conditional acceptance letter (It’s not a mandatory but a preferred file, with which students will be admitted in priority).10. Others preferred: academic achievements (important), certificates of sports or cultural activity.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health.2. Education and age requirements of the applicants:(1) Those pursuing bachelor degree must have a high school diploma and be under 25 years old;(2) Those pursuing master degree must have a bachelor's degree and be under 35 years old;(3) Those pursuing PhD degree must have a master's degree and be under 40 years old;(4) Non-degree program students should be under 45 years old.3. Non-other scholarship recipients.4. Language ability requirements:DegreeMediumLanguage RequirementsMaster & PhDChineseHSK5 ≥ 180(To apply for Humanity School majors needs HSK5 ≥ 210)EnglishIELTS≥6.0, TOEFL≥80, Duolingo≥100BachelorChineseHSK4 ≥ 180(To apply for Humanity School majors needs HSK5 ≥ 180)EnglishIELTS≥6.0, TOEFL≥80, Duolingo≥100Note:Applicants providing Chinese or English medium of instruction certificate are exempted from submitting corresponding certificate of language proficiency.
